description: Three stages on one clock: it reshapes the pulse width, multiplies the rate, and repeats each trigger a set number of times

params.text: Sets the pulse width as a share of the incoming clock's period, 0 to 100%, and the same share is applied to all three outputs
Sets how much of the pulse width CV reaches that knob, none at the far left and the whole of its travel at the far right
Sets how many pulses the multiplier puts out for each clock it receives, 1 to 16
Sets how much of the multiplier CV reaches that knob, none at the far left and its full 16 steps at the far right
Sets how many times each incoming trigger is repeated, 1 to 16, spaced at whatever rate the multiplier is running
Sets how much of the repeat CV reaches that knob, none at the far left and its full 16 steps at the far right

inputs.text: The clock whose pulse width is reshaped; its period is measured between rising edges past 2V
Adds to the pulse width knob, 10V covering the whole of its travel at full attenuation
The clock the multiplier subdivides, taken on rising edges past 2V; with nothing patched it uses the clock above it
Adds to the multiplier knob, 10V covering its full 16 steps at full attenuation
The trigger that fires a burst of repeats, taken on rising edges past 2V; with nothing patched it uses whichever clock the multiplier is using
Adds to the repeat knob, 10V covering its full 16 steps at full attenuation

outputs.text: The incoming clock with its pulse width reset by the pulse width knob, 10V high
A burst of repeats each time a trigger arrives, 10V high

notes: the multiplier measures the period between two clock edges, so the first cycle after a clock starts is not divided up
with only the top jack patched all three stages run from it, because the second input is normalled to the first and the third to the second

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.2:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the clock at the pulse width input; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.4:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the clock the multiplier is using; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.5:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
